_description: The CTS URN (the citation form of Perseus, Scaife and the Open Greek and Latin repositories) of each Latin and Greek work file, keyed by the whole-work file name; part files resolve to their work. "source" says how the entry was found: catalog (author and title matched in the Perseus / Open Greek and Latin inventories), url (the work's Perseus hopper page or credit row names the URN and its title agrees), manual (confirmed by reading the work's page) or none (a person looked and no CTS URN exists, so urn is null). scripts/corpus/cts_urns.py fills and checks it.
